paragraphs: He is mentioned in Shemot Rabbah 51:8, disagreeing with Rabbi Huna.[^1]

notes.text: The stored Midrash Rabbah — TE at Shemot Rabbah51:8 explicitly places Rabbi Sisa and Rabbi Huna's opinions side by side. That exact occurrence supports both Rabbi expansions; the abbreviation ר״ה alone could also denote Rav Huna. No teaching or global identity is imported.
